lines.japanese: 我が名はガルーダ・ダークブラック。またの名を伊丹伽楼羅。グレタガルドの王である。
lines.english: My name is Garuda Darkblack, also known as Karura Itami. I am the king of Gretagard.

lines.japanese: 元来、王とは城の奥に悠然と座したるものだ。
lines.english: By nature, a king sits at his ease in the innermost chamber of his castle.

lines.japanese: いくさやまつりごとは信頼のおける配下に委ね、自らは後方よりその采配を執る。それこそが元首たる者の務め。
lines.english: He entrusts war and statecraft to reliable subordinates and directs them from the rear. Such is the duty of a head of state.

lines.japanese: しかし、遺憾ながら、我が国はいま危急のときにある。
lines.english: To my regret, however, my country now faces a grave emergency.

lines.japanese: 私が闇の牢獄に囚われているうち、グレタガルドはニホンなどという文明勢力に呑みこまれてしまったのだ。
lines.english: While I languished in a prison of darkness, Gretagard was swallowed by a civilizational power called Japan.

lines.japanese: 兵も民も奪われた我ら王家の一族は、いまや異民族の占領下にて慎ましやかな隠遁生活を余儀なくされている。
lines.english: Robbed of both soldiers and subjects, we of the royal family are now forced to live in modest seclusion beneath the occupation of a foreign people.

lines.japanese: それは先代国王のご息女、麗しのプリンセス・ダヴとて例外ではない。
lines.english: Not even the lovely Princess Dove, daughter of the former king, is exempt.

lines.japanese: 正統な王の血を引く直系の彼女さえ、いまでは平民の風習にのっとり、城下の学び舎へ通っておられる日々なのだ。
lines.english: Though a direct descendant of the rightful royal blood, she now follows the customs of the common people and attends a school in the city each day.

lines.japanese: 「ゆえに、わたくし自らが小鳩様のお迎えにあがりました」
lines.english: “Therefore, I have come to collect Lady Kobato in person.”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ！？　いいい伊丹さん？」
lines.english: “Wha?! M-M-Mr. Itami?”

lines.japanese: 正門からお出になったところへ声をお掛けすると、ダヴ姫──現在はニホンの風習になぞらえて羽田小鳩という名を用いていらっしゃる──は、いささか表情を硬くされた御様子。
lines.english: When I addressed her as she emerged from the front gate, Princess Dove—who presently uses the name Kobato Haneda in accordance with Japanese custom—appeared to stiffen somewhat.

lines.japanese: 「それは、あの、お、お手すう、おかけしました。ででも、私はもう子どもじゃないので、お、送りむかえとかはいらんです。おき、おきづかいなくです」
lines.english: “Th-that's, um, v-very kind of you. B-but I'm not a child anymore, so I don't need anybody to pick me up or take me home. Pl-please don't worry about me.”

lines.japanese: 「何を申されるか。御身に万一のことあらば、奈落の名に懸けて、このガルーダ・ダークブラ──」
lines.english: “What are you saying? Should any calamity befall you, then in the name of the abyss, this Garuda Darkbl—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああっ！　いいですいいです、おともだちの前でそうゆうのはいいです！」
lines.english: “Ah! That's enough, that's enough! Please don't do that in front of my friends!”

lines.japanese: 姫は両手を振りみだして私の言葉を遮った。彼女のかたわらにいた学友が、羨望の声をあげる。
lines.english: The princess waved both hands wildly to cut me off. The schoolmate at her side raised her voice in envy.

lines.japanese: 「わあ、いいなあ羽田さん。お兄さんが迎えに来てくれるなんてー」
lines.english: “Wow, you're so lucky, Haneda. Your big brother came to pick you up.”

lines.japanese: オニイサン。
lines.english: Big brother.

lines.japanese: ふむん、さようであったな。現在、平民に身をやつしている我々は、下々の世において兄と妹という触れ込みであった。
lines.english: Hrnn. Yes, of course. Disguised as commoners, we were passing ourselves off as brother and sister in the world of the lower orders.

lines.japanese: 「うぉんむ、うぉんむ。娘よ、日ごろ妹が世話になっておるようだな。礼を申すぞ」
lines.english: “Wom, wom. Girl, I understand that my sister is indebted to you for your daily companionship. You have my thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「ああーっ！　あのあの、ちがうの吉川さん！　あのね、うちのお兄ちゃん、時代劇が大好きでね！」
lines.english: “Ah! N-no, that's not it, Yoshikawa! See, my big brother is a huge fan of historical dramas!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうなんですかあ。ふふっ、かっこいいです」
lines.english: “Oh, is that it? Hee-hee. He sounds cool.”

lines.japanese: 「もはは、世辞を申すな。愛いやつめ」
lines.english: “Mohaha! Spare me your flattery, charming creature.”

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃん、あの、ごめんなさい……私、きょうは吉川さんと寄り道する約束してて……」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother, um, I'm sorry... I promised Yoshikawa we'd stop somewhere together today...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　いいよ羽田さん、せっかくお兄さん来てくれたんだから、私はまた今度で」
lines.english: “What? That's okay, Haneda. Your brother went to all this trouble to come, so we can do it another day.”

lines.japanese: 「なんと！　いや、それはなりませんぞ。グレタガルドのことわざに『孤独の闇は死霊も避ける』とあるとおり、トモダチとは人生を照らす光なれば、みだりに盟約破りこれを裏切るべからず」
lines.english: “What! No, that shall not stand. As the Gretagardian proverb says, ‘Even the dead shun the darkness of solitude.’ A friend is a light that illuminates life. One must not wantonly break a covenant and betray that light.”

lines.japanese: 「さあさあ姫、あいや妹よ、友という名の灯火をたずさえ、いずこともへと参るがよい。さあさあ」
lines.english: “Come, Princess—nay, my sister. Bear aloft the flame called friendship and go wherever it may lead you. Go now.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん……でも、ちゃんと帰れますか」
lines.english: “O-okay... But can you get home by yourself?”

lines.japanese: 「心配召さるな。賢者王に不可能はござらん」
lines.english: “Have no fear. Nothing lies beyond the Wise King's powers.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうでござるか……じゃあ、ごめんなさい。気をつけて帰ってください」
lines.english: “I-is it so...? Then, forgive me. Please take care on your way home.”

lines.japanese: 「ははあっ！　慈しみ深きお心遣い、かたじけのうござりまする」
lines.english: “Your compassionate concern does me the greatest honor!”

lines.japanese: 「も、もう危ないこととかは、しちゃだめでござりまするよ。怒ったりけんかしたりは禁止です」
lines.english: “Y-you mustn’t do anything dangerous henceforth. No getting angry and no fighting.”

lines.japanese: 「御意」
lines.english: “As you command.”

lines.japanese: 私は一礼したのち、両者を東のかたへと送りだした。
lines.english: I bowed, then sent the pair on their way to the east.

lines.japanese: 東は陽の出ずるかた。願わくば、彼女らの友情に久遠の光あらんことを。
lines.english: The east is the realm of the rising sun. May their friendship be blessed with eternal light.

lines.japanese: 「るふぅ……」
lines.english: “Hrrfoo...”

lines.japanese: 残された私は息をつき、ひとり手持無沙汰に空を見上げた。冬の黄昏どきはよく冷える。
lines.english: Left behind, I exhaled and looked idly up at the sky. Winter twilight is a cold hour.

lines.japanese: ふと気付けば、胃のあたりに幽かな鈍痛があった。
lines.english: I suddenly became aware of a faint, dull ache near my stomach.

lines.japanese: はて。なんなのだろう、この、靄のごとく湧いた不鮮明な情動は。
lines.english: What could it be, this indistinct emotion rising like mist?

lines.japanese: これは、この感情は……さ、さび？　さび、さび、し……い……？
lines.english: This emotion was... lone? Lone, lone... loneliness...?

lines.japanese: 「ウヴァアァァァー！」
lines.english: “UVAAAAAAGH!”

lines.japanese: 不意に得体の知れぬ恐怖がこの身を呑みこまんとしたので、私は気合一閃、頭を振りみだして黒い靄を祓った。
lines.english: An incomprehensible terror abruptly threatened to consume me. With one fierce burst of spirit, I shook my head wildly and scattered the black mist.

lines.japanese: 「え、なにあのひと……」
lines.english: “What is with that guy...?”

lines.japanese: 「やだ、こわーい」
lines.english: “Ew, scary.”

lines.japanese: 図らずも滲みでてしまった王者の気炎に、学び舎の娘たちが戦慄していた。
lines.english: The maidens of the academy trembled before the royal fighting spirit I had inadvertently allowed to seep forth.

lines.japanese: まあよい、捨ておこう。いたずらに立ちつくしていても詮なきこと、羽田城へ戻るとしよう。
lines.english: No matter. I shall leave them be. Nothing can be gained by standing idly here. Let us return to Castle Haneda.

lines.japanese: 「ふむん？　はて、帰路はどちらだ」
lines.english: “Hrnn? Now, which way is home?”

lines.japanese: ここまでは『たくしぃ』なる辻馬車で参ったが、復路については考えておらなんだ。
lines.english: I had come here aboard a street carriage known as a *taxi*, but had given no thought to the return journey.

lines.japanese: 「おい、そこの娘たちよ。余の城はどこだ」
lines.english: “Ho, maidens. Where is my castle?”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃあああ！　こっち来た、ありえねー！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah! It's coming this way! No way!”

lines.japanese: 「……ふぬん」
lines.english: “...Hrnn.”

lines.japanese: 役立たずの雌ゴブリンどもめ。王の威厳に圧倒され、恐慌を引きおこしおったか。
lines.english: Useless female goblins. The royal majesty overwhelmed them and sent them into a panic, I see.

lines.japanese: しかしあの者ども、雑兵の分際で小癪な眼をしおる。
lines.english: And yet those foot soldiers possess strangely impertinent eyes.

lines.japanese: あるいはマインドアタックの眼力術やもしれぬな。あの白き眼に当てられると、このガルーダとて、どうにも不安で居たたまれない心持ちになるわ。
lines.english: Perhaps they wield some ocular art of mental attack. Faced with those cold stares, even Garuda feels anxious and ill at ease.

lines.japanese: 「あー、ちょっと、あんた誰。なに、うちの生徒に何か用？」
lines.english: “Hey, you. Who are you? You got some business with one of our students?”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 無礼な誰何に振りかえってみると、制服姿の警吏が立っていた。オーガ鬼のごとく愛嬌のない面相だ。
lines.english: I turned at the insolent challenge and found a uniformed guard standing there, with a face as unwelcoming as an ogre’s.

lines.japanese: 「困るんですよねえ、関係者じゃないひとにこの辺いられると。まあ、とりあえず中で話しましょうか」
lines.english: “We can't have unauthorized people hanging around here. Why don't you come inside and have a little talk with me?”

lines.japanese: 警吏の手が私の腕を捕えた。その理不尽な握力は、我が存在意義たるあの激情に火を入れた。
lines.english: The guard seized my arm. That outrageously strong grip set a flame to the violent passion that gives my existence its meaning.

lines.japanese: 赤黒い衝動が降りてくる。敵愾心。攻撃性。殺意──
lines.english: The red-black impulse descended. Hostility. Aggression. Bloodlust—

lines.japanese: ──誰かをやっつけてやりたいと思う気持ち。
lines.english: —the urge to give somebody a sound thrashing.

lines.japanese: 「ウ、ウうぅうウゥぅ……」
lines.english: “U-uuuhhhrrr...”

lines.japanese: だが私は懸命にこらえた。
lines.english: Yet I fought with all my strength to endure it.

lines.japanese: プリンセス・ダヴの意思は天の意思も同じ。
lines.english: Princess Dove's will is the will of heaven.

lines.japanese: 私に怒りを禁じた彼女の命は、絶対の制約。
lines.english: Her command forbidding me anger is an absolute constraint.

lines.japanese: ガルーダ・ダークブラックの本質を否定してさえ遵守されねばならない。
lines.english: It must be obeyed even at the cost of denying the very nature of Garuda Darkblack.

lines.japanese: 「せ、せかイが……へい、平ワで……」
lines.english: “M-may the world... be at p-peace...”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと、あんた、ぶつぶつ言ってないで早く来なさい。いい加減にしないと警察呼ぶよ」
lines.english: “Hey, quit muttering and come with me. Keep this up and I'm calling the police.”

lines.japanese: 「へへへい、ワデ……アる、あルます……よ、ヨウ、よう……」
lines.english: “B-b-be at... p-peace... M-may it... be...”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん！」
lines.english: “Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: そのとき、私と警吏のあいだに水兵服の娘が飛びこんできた。それはあろうことか我が敬愛すべき──
lines.english: At that moment, a maiden in a sailor uniform leaped between the guard and me. It was, impossibly, my own revered—

lines.japanese: 「──はぽん！　小鳩様！」
lines.english: “—Hapon! Lady Kobato!”

lines.japanese: 「んん？　なんだね、君は」
lines.english: “Hm? And who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「すすすすいません、このひと私の兄なんです、あの、ぜんぜんふしん人物ではないです、せいれんけっぱくです、じんちくむがいです」
lines.english: “I-I-I'm sorry. This man is my brother. He's not suspicious at all. He's pure and innocent and completely harmless.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、なんと畏れ多い……姫よ、わたくしを庇うために戻ってきてくださったのですか……」
lines.english: “Oh, what an undeserved honor... Princess, did you return to protect me...?”

lines.japanese: にわかに目頭が熱くなった。
lines.english: My eyes suddenly grew hot.

lines.japanese: なんたる栄誉。身に余るお心使いに、私は感極まり、その小さな体を抱きしめずにはおれなかった。
lines.english: What an honor. Her gracious concern moved me beyond endurance, and I could not help but embrace her tiny body.
“Princess...”

lines.japanese: 「ふぇ？」
lines.english: “Wha?”

lines.japanese: 「姫ぇぇぇーッ！」
lines.english: “Princessss!”

lines.japanese: 「ひっ、うえええーっ！？」
lines.english: “Eek! Whaaaa?!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ貴様！　当校の生徒に何をするかー！」
lines.english: “You! What are you doing to one of our students?!”

lines.japanese: その後。
lines.english: Afterward—

lines.japanese: いっとき我々は身柄を拘束されたが、姫が警吏に弁明をすると、紛らわしいから兄妹喧嘩なら家でやれ、との訓告を受けつつ釈放された。
lines.english: —we were detained for a time. Once the princess explained matters to the guard, we were released with a warning to keep sibling quarrels at home rather than give people the wrong idea.

lines.japanese: 「人生は誤解のれんぞくです……」
lines.english: “Life is an endless succession of misunderstandings...”

lines.japanese: 「いかがなされた、姫。だいぶお疲れのようですが」
lines.english: “What troubles you, Princess? You appear quite exhausted.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、それです。日本ではあいての顔色をうかがうことがだいじです」
lines.english: “That. That's what I mean. In Japan, it's important to read the other person's expression.”

lines.japanese: 「成る程、さようでしたか。ううむ、やはり小鳩様との対話は実りが多い」
lines.english: “I see. So that is the way of it. Hmm. Conversation with Lady Kobato is as fruitful as ever.”

lines.japanese: ダヴ姫は日々の往復に鉄道を用いているということで、いま我々は駅舎までの道中を並び歩いていた。
lines.english: Princess Dove told me that she traveled back and forth by rail each day, and so we were now walking side by side toward the station.

lines.japanese: 「ふむん……」
lines.english: “Hrnn...”

lines.japanese: 「え？　えっ？　あの、なんですか？」
lines.english: “What? Wh-what is it?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ。さっそく教えにならい、小鳩様の面貌を観察しております」
lines.english: “Nothing. I am merely putting your lesson into practice by observing Lady Kobato's face.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうむ、やはりお美しい、この目鼻立ちは神々の創りたもうた芸術と言っても過言では……」
lines.english: “Hmm. As beautiful as I expected. It would be no exaggeration to call these features a work of art fashioned by the gods...”

lines.japanese: 「ちちち、ちがいます、顔色をうかがうとゆうのは、そうゆう意味ではないです」
lines.english: “Th-th-that's not what it means! Reading my expression doesn't mean literally inspecting my face.”

lines.japanese: なんと。るふう、ニホン語とは解しがたいのう。
lines.english: What! Hrrfoo, the Japanese language defies comprehension.

lines.japanese: 「ところで姫、ご友人との遊覧の儀はよろしかったのですか」
lines.english: “By the way, Princess, what of your excursion with your friend?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、はい。吉川さんとは、またこんど遊びにいきます」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. Yoshikawa and I will go out another time.”

lines.japanese: 「さようか……しかし畏れながら申しあげますが、ヒトとヒトとの絆は何ものにも勝る宝なれば、あだや疎かにしてはなりませんぞ」
lines.english: “I see... Forgive my presumption, but the bond between person and person is a treasure beyond all others. It must not be treated lightly.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、だから戻ってきました。やっぱり、伊丹さんがせっかく迎えに来てくれたんだから」
lines.english: “I know. That's why I came back. You went to all the trouble of coming for me, Mr. Itami.”
“Hrnn...?”

lines.japanese: なんだ、いま胸に妙な違和感が……。
lines.english: What was that peculiar sensation in my chest...?

lines.japanese: 「吉川さんにはいつでも会えるけど、伊丹さんにはいつ会えるか分からないし」
lines.english: “I can see Yoshikawa anytime. I never know when I'll get to see you again.”

lines.japanese: 「ふぬぅ！」
lines.english: “Hrrngh!”

lines.japanese: 「ふぇっ！？　ななな、なんですか、どうしたんですか」
lines.english: “Wha?! Wh-what is it? What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「ああいえ、失敬。いま何やらこう、心ノ臓あたりにぎゅるりと妙な差し込みを感じたもので」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Forgive me. I merely felt a peculiar pang twist through the region of my heart.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！　だだ、だいじょぶですか、病院に行きますか！」
lines.english: “What?! A-are you okay? Do you need a hospital?!”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、それには及びますまい。何と申したものか、奇妙なことに、不快な痛みではないのです」
lines.english: “No, that will not be necessary. Strangely, I would not describe the pain as unpleasant.”

lines.japanese: 「はあー、そでしたか。よくわかんないけど、それならよかったです。伊丹さんはいつもむちゃをするので、私はとても心配です」
lines.english: “Oh, okay. I don't really understand, but I'm glad. You always do reckless things, Mr. Itami, so I worry about you a lot.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐ……ふぬぅ……」
lines.english: “Guh... Hrrngh...”

lines.japanese: まただ。またあの差し込み。
lines.english: Again. Again, that pang.

lines.japanese: なんなのだこれは。新種の感冒であろうか。今年のグレタガルド風邪は性質が悪いと聞くからのう。
lines.english: What could this be? Some new variety of cold? I have heard that this year's Gretagardian cold is a particularly vicious strain.

lines.japanese: 「えくしっ！」
lines.english: “Achoo!”

lines.japanese: ややっ、これはいかん、言ってるそばから姫がくしゃみをなされた。おのれ、ちょこざいなグレタガルド風邪め。くっさめ、くっさめ。
lines.english: Oh! This will not do. No sooner had I spoken than the princess sneezed. Curse you, impudent Gretagardian cold. Blessings, blessings.

lines.japanese: 「姫、これを」
lines.english: “Princess, take this.”

lines.japanese: 私は外套を脱いで、彼女の肩に覆いかぶせた。
lines.english: I removed my coat and draped it over her shoulders.
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 一瞬その体が跳ねるように固まった。
lines.english: For an instant, her body seemed to jump and stiffen.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ありがとござる……」
lines.english: “Th-thank you kindly...”

lines.japanese: 「礼には及びませぬ。ご自愛くだされ」
lines.english: “No thanks are needed. Take good care of yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい……ども、気をつけます……」
lines.english: “O-okay... I will. Thank you...”

lines.japanese: ぎこちなく襟を寄せながら、その身が外套の中へ埋もれてゆく。
lines.english: She awkwardly drew the collar closed, and her body disappeared inside my coat.

lines.japanese: そして裏地にくんと鼻を寄せてから、私を見上げ、微笑んだ。
lines.english: Then she pressed her nose to the lining and sniffed, looked up at me, and smiled.

lines.japanese: 「あったかい……えへっ」
lines.english: “It's warm... Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: その笑顔を向けられた刹那、何故だか胸を張り裂かんばかりの甘やかな衝撃が私を撃ちぬいた。
lines.english: The instant she turned that smile on me, a sweet impact powerful enough to tear my heart apart shot through my chest.

lines.japanese: 「ウヴァアアアー！」
lines.english: “UVAAAAAAGH!”

lines.japanese: 「ひいっ！？　ななな、なんか分かんないけどごめんなさいぃー！？」
lines.english: “Eek?! I-I don't know what I did, but I'm sorryyy!”

lines.japanese: 恐るべしプリンセス・ダヴ。
lines.english: Princess Dove is fearsome indeed.

lines.japanese: ゆくゆくは手練れの雷撃使いになるであろう。
lines.english: In time, she will surely become a master wielder of lightning.

lines.japanese: 私はその秘められた素養に魅せられてならない。
lines.english: I cannot help but be enchanted by that hidden potential.
